variants.name: Pricing Table — Neo-Brutalism

Press-down hover states and monospace labels give it a raw, editorial character.

variants.name: Pricing Table — Sharp Glassmorphism
variants.description: Frosted-glass three-tier SaaS pricing table floating over an animated gradient mesh — translucent panels with backdrop blur, luminous top edge highlights, a gradient CTA on the popular tier with a cyan glow badge, check/dash feature lists, and a working monthly/annual billing toggle that swaps the displayed prices live. Hover lift states add depth to the glass cards.
features: highlighted popular tier with gradient CTA and cyan glow badge

variants.name: Pricing Table — Vercel
variants.description: Dark monochrome three-tier SaaS pricing table with hairline borders, generous spacing, white/white-50/white-35 text hierarchy, a single teal accent on the popular badge, check/dash feature lists, and a working monthly/annual billing toggle that swaps the displayed prices live. White primary CTA and subtle hover fills give it a refined, product-grade feel.
features: highlighted popular tier with teal dot badge

variants.name: SaaS Product Hero — Vercel
variants.description: Minimal monochrome SaaS product hero with a left-aligned two-line gradient headline, dual CTAs, trust logo row, a masked grid backdrop, and a framed dark product UI preview with sidebar, inbox rows, and a floating SLA stat chip. Single teal accent and hairline borders for a premium enterprise feel.
features: primary white CTA + secondary ghost demo CTA
framed product UI preview with sidebar and inbox

variants.name: Product Workflow Section — Vercel
variants.description: Dark monochrome numbered workflow section with a left step rail and a right sticky code/command preview that swaps per step. Three steps (ingest, route, resolve) with teal accent connectors, and a working step switcher that updates the preview panel live via a scoped script.
features: left step rail with teal connectors
working step switcher that swaps preview live

variants.name: Product Screenshot Showcase — Sharp Glassmorphism
variants.description: Frosted-glass product screenshot showcase over an animated gradient mesh — a tabbed gallery with a large framed screenshot, thumbnail tabs, and caption metadata. Active tab swaps the preview live via a scoped script. Cyan glow accents and luminous edges.
features: thumbnail tabs that swap preview live

variants.name: Testimonial Grid — Sharp Glassmorphism
variants.description: Frosted-glass asymmetric testimonial grid over an animated gradient mesh — one large featured quote tile with gradient quote mark, two medium quote tiles, and two compact stat-quote tiles. Avatar initials chips, role labels, and luminous top edges with hover lift.
features: large featured quote tile with gradient quote mark

variants.name: Free Trial CTA — Neo-Brutalism
variants.description: Brutalist full-bleed free trial CTA banner with a giant headline, a no-credit-card checklist strip, dual offset-shadow CTAs, a diagonal grid background, and a rotated guarantee sticker. Press-down hover states and bright accent blocks give it a loud, confident close.

variants.name: Usage Based Pricing — Neo-Brutalism
variants.description: Brutalist usage-based pricing section with a draggable usage slider that recomputes the live estimate, a stacked tier-rate table with hard borders, a volume savings bar, and offset-shadow CTAs. Monospace labels and bright accent panels give it a raw, transparent pricing feel.
features: draggable usage slider that recomputes live estimate
